import sys

def main():
    data = sys.stdin.buffer.read().split()
    N = int(data[0])
    A = [int(x) for x in data[1:1+N]]
    
    NEG_INF = float('-inf')
    # dp0: max sum with even number of kept elements (or zero)
    # dp1: max sum with odd number of kept elements (last kept is at an odd position)
    dp0 = 0
    dp1 = NEG_INF
    
    for i in range(1, N + 1):
        a = A[i - 1]
        if i % 2 == 1:  # odd position: can extend dp0 -> dp1 by picking this
            new_dp1 = dp1 if dp1 >= dp0 + a else dp0 + a
            dp1 = new_dp1
            # dp0 unchanged (can't close pair on odd position)
        else:  # even position: can extend dp1 -> dp0 by picking this
            cand = dp1 + a if dp1 != NEG_INF else NEG_INF
            new_dp0 = dp0 if dp0 >= cand else cand
            dp0 = new_dp0
            # dp1 unchanged (can't open pair on even position)
    
    if N % 2 == 0:
        print(dp0)
    else:
        print(dp1)
